eyebrow: A container's own disk disappears with it

steps.label: emptyDir
steps.sub: scratch storage — gone the moment the Pod is removed

steps.label: PersistentVolume
steps.sub: real cluster storage, provisioned ahead of time

steps.label: PersistentVolumeClaim
steps.sub: a request that binds to a matching PV

eyebrow: PV — an actual piece of storage
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: catalog-db-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 20Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  awsElasticBlockStore:
    volumeID: vol-0abcd1234efgh5678
    fsType: ext4
caption: A cluster-level resource, independent of any namespace or Pod.

eyebrow: PVC — the Pod mounts the claim, not the PV
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: catalog-db-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
---
volumes:
  - name: db-storage
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: catalog-db-pvc
caption: The Pod never needs to know whether the real storage is EBS, Azure Disk, or NFS.

subtitle: Skipping the step of pre-creating every PV by hand.
